mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Detail lookup (specific tender/award ID(s) or URL(s))
mode.description: 'latest' = currently-open tenders from the Live Tenders bulletin board. 'former' = closed/historical tenders. 'awards' = recent contract award notices (awardee, contract amount -- only the most recent ~100 are reachable, see README). 'detail' = fetch specific tender/award ID(s) directly.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Applies to 'latest', 'former', and 'awards' -- how many listing rows to return (paginates 20 rows/page for latest+former; awards is capped at whatever the site's own most-recent page returns, see README).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full detail per item
fetchDetails.description: For 'latest'/'former'/'awards': also fetch each item's full detail page (all labeled fields, plus any line-item breakdown table) and merge it in as 'detail'. Slower but much richer output. Ignored by 'detail' mode (which always fetches full detail).

tenderIds.title: Tender IDs or URLs
tenderIds.description: Mode 'detail' only. Numeric tender ID(s) (e.g. "46190") or full viewLiveTenderDetails URLs. Works for tenders in any status (live, closed, awarded).

awardIds.title: Award notice IDs or URLs
awardIds.description: Mode 'detail' only. Numeric award notice ID(s) (e.g. "8501") or full viewAwardNotice URLs.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many detail-page lookups to run in parallel (used by all modes when fetching detail).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Off by default -- no WAF/CAPTCHA was found on this target (confirmed across multiple TLS/browser profiles), so a direct connection works reliably.
